IA_NAME_MISSING: Your name is missing from {cell} on the Income Analysis tab. Type it in so your work can be identified as yours.
IA_SLOPE_MISSING: Your slope ({cell}) is missing a SLOPE formula. Enter =SLOPE(B19:B26,A19:A26), with the incomes first and the years second.
IA_SLOPE_CORRECT: Your slope formula in {cell} is correct.
IA_SLOPE_REVERSED: Your slope ({cell}) has the x- and y-ranges swapped. The incomes should come first and the years second: =SLOPE(B19:B26,A19:A26).
IA_SLOPE_WRONG_RANGE: Your slope ({cell}) uses SLOPE, but not the right ranges. It should be =SLOPE(B19:B26,A19:A26).
IA_INTERCEPT_MISSING: Your intercept ({cell}) is missing an INTERCEPT formula. Enter =INTERCEPT(B19:B26,A19:A26), with the incomes first and the years second.
IA_INTERCEPT_CORRECT: Your intercept formula in {cell} is correct.
IA_INTERCEPT_REVERSED: Your intercept ({cell}) has the x- and y-ranges swapped. The incomes should come first and the years second: =INTERCEPT(B19:B26,A19:A26).
IA_INTERCEPT_WRONG_RANGE: Your intercept ({cell}) uses INTERCEPT, but not the right ranges. It should be =INTERCEPT(B19:B26,A19:A26).
IA_SLOPE_FORMAT_CORRECT: Your slope in {cell} is formatted correctly.
IA_SLOPE_FORMAT_INCORRECT: Your slope ({cell}) should be formatted as a Number with 0 decimal places.
IA_INTERCEPT_FORMAT_CORRECT: Your intercept in {cell} is formatted correctly.
IA_INTERCEPT_FORMAT_INCORRECT: Your intercept ({cell}) should be formatted as a Number with 0 decimal places.
IA_PREDICTIONS_ALL_CORRECT: Your predicted income formulas in {range} are correct.
IA_PREDICTIONS_NONE_CORRECT: None of your predicted income formulas ({range}) are working yet. Each should be the slope times that row's years plus the intercept, like =B30*D19+B31.
IA_PREDICTIONS_PARTIAL: Only {correct} of your {total} predicted income formulas ({range}) work as expected. Each one should be like =B30*D19+B31: the slope times that row's years plus the intercept. Rows that need work: {issues}.
IA_PREDICTIONS_HARDCODED: {count} of your predicted income formulas ({range}) type in the slope and intercept instead of pointing to B30 and B31. Use a formula like =B30*D19+B31 so they update automatically.
IA_PREDICTIONS_NOT_FORMULAS: {count} of your predicted incomes ({range}) are typed-in numbers instead of formulas. Use a formula like =B30*D19+B31 so they update automatically.
IA_PREDICTIONS_MISSING_REFS: {count} of your predicted income formulas ({range}) don't use the slope (B30) and intercept (B31) correctly. Each should be like =B30*D19+B31.
IA_PREDICTIONS_MISSING_YEARS: {count} of your predicted income formulas ({range}) don't use that row's years of experience in column D. Each should be like =B30*D19+B31.
IA_PREDICTIONS_REFS_BUT_WRONG_VALUE: {count} of your predicted income formulas ({range}) use B30 and B31 but don't give the right value. Each should be the slope times that row's years plus the intercept, like =B30*D19+B31.
IA_PREDICTIONS_VALUE_BUT_NO_REFS: {count} of your predicted incomes ({range}) have the right value, but they should be formulas that use B30 and B31, like =B30*D19+B31.
IA_PRED_FORMAT_ALL_CORRECT: Your predicted incomes in {range} are formatted correctly.
IA_PRED_FORMAT_NONE_CORRECT: Your predicted incomes ({range}) should be formatted as Currency with 0 decimal places.
IA_PRED_FORMAT_PARTIAL: Only {correct} of your {total} predicted incomes ({range}) are formatted as Currency with 0 decimal places. The whole range should use that format.
IA_SCATTER_NOT_CHECKED: Your scatterplot isn't graded automatically. Your instructor will review it by hand.
IA_SCATTER_NOT_FOUND: No XY scatter chart was found on the Income Analysis tab. Insert one using the BLS income data in columns A and B.
IA_SCATTER_FOUND: Your XY scatter chart is present.
IA_SCATTER_HAS_LINES: Your scatter chart connects the data points with lines. A scatter plot should show markers only (the trendline is separate), so switch it to Scatter with only Markers.
IA_SCATTER_WRONG_DATA: Your scatter chart isn't plotting the right data. It should use the BLS data in columns A and B, not your predicted values.
IA_SCATTER_DATA_UNVERIFIED: [MANUAL REVIEW] The chart's data source could not be read automatically. Confirm it plots the BLS data (columns A and B) and award up to 3 of the chart points.
IA_SCATTER_TITLE_MISSING: Your chart is missing a title. Add one that describes the data.
IA_SCATTER_XLABEL_MISSING: Your chart is missing an x-axis label. Add one that says what the x-axis shows, such as Years of Experience.
IA_SCATTER_YLABEL_MISSING: Your chart is missing a y-axis label. Add one that says what the y-axis shows, such as Income.
IA_SCATTER_TRENDLINE_MISSING: Your chart is missing a trendline. Add a linear trendline to show the relationship between years and income.
IA_SCATTER_EXTENDED_MISSING: Your trendline should be extended to cover {expected_min} to {expected_max} years. In Format Trendline, set Forecast Forward and Backward so it reaches that range.
